mapper.select: SELECT b.son_id AS childMaterialId, b.s_material_name AS childMaterialName, COALESCE(m.parameter, '') AS specParameter, COALESCE(m.describe, '') AS specDescribe, COALESCE(m.draw_no, '') AS specDrawNo, COALESCE(m.color, '') AS specColor, b.fenzi / NULLIF(b.fenmu, 0) AS usageQty, b.loss_rate AS lossRate, b.unit, COALESCE(m.buy_type, '') AS materialAttr, b.son_no AS sortNo, b.bom_ver AS bomVer FROM 清洗_物料清单主数据 b LEFT JOIN 清洗_物料主数据 m ON b.son_id = m.material_id WHERE b.father_id = #{materialId} AND b.bom_ver = #{version} AND b.is_valid = 1 ORDER BY b.son_no
SELECT DISTINCT bom_ver FROM 清洗_物料清单主数据 WHERE father_id = #{materialId} AND is_valid = 1 ORDER BY bom_ver DESC
